name: framegen
note: Frame generation (frame_generation = 1, AMD FSR 3; --set frame_generation=2 for NVIDIA DLSS) in a room with the camera turning, its libraries from the build folder or CV_FRAMEGEN_DIR: the log says whether it generates. XBE_FG_SHOW_MOTION=1 draws the motion vectors over the frame (grey still, red right, green down), XBE_FG_DEBUG=1 AMD's tear lines on the generated frames.

steps.until: map == 3 and room == 2 and player.active and not loading
